resources.title: Modding: Installing mods — bg3.wiki
resources.creator: bg3.wiki
resources.noteEs: La guía base para instalar mods en BG3: prerequisitos, carpeta de Mods, .pak files y el flujo con BG3 Mod Manager. El primer punto de lectura antes de modear nada.
resources.noteEn: The base guide to installing BG3 mods: prerequisites, the Mods folder, .pak files, and the BG3 Mod Manager flow. The first thing to read before modding anything.

resources.title: Install BG3MM (BG3 Mod Manager) — BG3 Modding Community Wiki
resources.creator: BG3 Modding Community
resources.noteEs: Tutorial paso a paso para instalar y configurar BG3 Mod Manager desde la fuente oficial. La referencia canónica de la comunidad de modders, sin mirrors dudosos.
resources.noteEn: A step-by-step tutorial for installing and configuring BG3 Mod Manager from the official source. The modding community's canonical reference, with no dubious mirrors.

resources.title: Mod Types and how to install them — BG3 Modding Community Wiki
resources.creator: BG3 Modding Community
resources.noteEs: Explica que no todos los mods se instalan igual: .pak, native dll, replacers y frameworks tienen flujos distintos. Clave para entender por qué un mod no carga aunque lo hayas puesto bien.
resources.noteEn: Explains that not all mods install the same way: .pak, native dll, replacers, and frameworks have different flows. Key to understanding why a mod won't load even when you placed it right.

resources.title: How To Install (& Use) Baldur's Gate 3 Mod Manager
resources.creator: ScreenRant
resources.noteEs: Guía editorial accesible para quien instala mods por primera vez: pasos de BG3 Mod Manager explicados sin asumir conocimiento técnico previo. Buen complemento a las wikis más densas.
resources.noteEn: An accessible editorial guide for first-time mod installers: BG3 Mod Manager steps explained without assuming prior technical knowledge. A good complement to the denser wikis.

resources.title: Best Baldur's Gate 3 mods & how to install them
resources.creator: GGRecon
resources.noteEs: Lista curada de mods recomendados junto con el proceso de instalación. Útil para decidir qué mods valen la pena una vez que ya sabes instalarlos.
resources.noteEn: A curated list of recommended mods alongside the installation process. Useful for deciding which mods are worth it once you already know how to install them.
